text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a proactive drain-validation run tonight that pairs burn-in CPU/GPU stress with a netlink/network interrupt storm on a small subset of suspect racks (g2-21, g2-22). Aim is to reproduce the intermittent ECC/Xid spike we saw when nodes are being drained under load.

Leo: Nice — what's the plan for scope and time window?

maya: Scope: 4 nodes per rack, one rack per AZ; window: 22:00-02:00 PT. We'll mark nodes maintenance and route traffic away via canary pool. Estimated impact: ~2% capacity reduction in those AZs.

sanjay: Can we add kernel dmesg live-stream + nvlink telemetry capture? If Xid shows up we want the per-GPU PCIe reset traces.

maya: yes — test harness will run `nvtop --log` and collect `dmesg -w` into /tmp/burnin-logs, plus periodic `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv` snapshots. I'll attach runbook in the job.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created: `burnin-netlink-stress-2054321111` on pool: dedicated-burnin-az1. ETA: 22:00 PT. Owner: maya. :white_check_mark:

Evan: Are we okay with the autoscaler behaving when capacity dips? I can pin a small extra buffer if you want. Also watch for region-aware routing fallback.

maya: Good call — please add +1 instance in AZ2 for the window, Evan. I'll update the traffic-policy to prefer healthy racks.

tina: For reproducibility, can we seed the netlink storm with `tc qdisc netem` plus a custom UDP flood to the node mgmt interface? I have a short script — will push to the job container. Example snippet:```bash
# run on burnin container
sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 5ms loss 0.1%
python3 netlink_flood.py --duration 20m --pps 5000
```

Leo: Add watchers on the drain automation: if any GPU reports Xid>=45 within 30m, trigger immediate node quarantine and DO NOT auto-return. We had false-positives before.

maya: Agreed. Will set threshold Xid>=45 and require manual triage. Also enabling kv-cache validation and running a quick model-runner smoke every 10m to ensure inference path remains sane.

sanjay: If we get thermal anomalies + Xid simultaneously, capture sensor telemetry at 1s frequency. I can build a one-off collector.

ops-bot: Job `burnin-netlink-stress-2054321111` started at 2054321400. Logs streaming to s3://redwood-burnin-logs/2054321111/

Evan: Thx — I bumped AZ2 pool by +1 for 22:00-03:00 PT. Will monitor autoscaler during the run.

maya: Running now. If anyone sees sustained error rates or capacity regressions, ping here with snapshot and tag me. TL;DR: validate drain+network stress reproduces ECC/Xid pattern without autoscale cascading.

tina: Noted. Pushing `netlink_flood.py` and collector to job image.

sanjay: If we can't reproduce, next step is to run EEPROM thermal cycling on the same nodes during stress.

maya: Yep — escalation path documented in runbook. Will update post-run with quick findings. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
